rows.text: returns without work when qword `02B47740` is null; otherwise calls the function at `003C9900` + 0xE and, when qword `02B47740` (re-read) is non-null, clears bit 16 (0x10000) of its dword `+0x40` and sets it again when that call returned 1, then tail-jumps (`003C9900` + 0x38) with `rcx` = the re-read qword

notes: 003C9900: the tail jump runs even when the re-read qword is null (rcx is then 0).
